summary: A SLOOP-based groovebox firmware drawn as a pixel-art RPG, where tracks are heroes, lit steps are attacks and recording is a boss fight.
features: SLOOP's four tracks, nine engines, drums, arpeggiator, sequencer and song mode
Notes charge each hero's ultimate; monsters, bosses, village and 3D flight scenes
Party stage decides which heroes play; Piano Hero and FM Hero games
Synthesised Brazilian kits and instruments such as cavaquinho and berimbau
Beta; samples stored at 11 to 16 kHz, so slightly duller
Flash is nearly full; controls follow SLOOP unchanged

headings: the "rpg style" notice a small personal test, hehe
